title: Literature check: crawler repair and re-nucleation are variants of known wave-pinning competition and subcritical motility onset; ringed swim-divide cells are a variant of Demarchi et al.'s self-propelling, dividing enzyme condensates, which the ledger has never run
summary: Prior art for the results decided since 17:55, from abstract pages opened this session. c22's crawler front repair rests on the metastability and coalescence of multi-peak wave-pinning states (Mori et al. 2008), and re-nucleation on subcritical motility onset (Ziebert et al. 2012). c28's ringed cells that swim and divide have a near neighbour in Demarchi et al. 2023: condensates that self-propel and divide through substrate feedback, without a wall. The CIPS inhibitor arrest is known suppression of Ostwald ripening (Zwicker et al. 2015). The evoloop small-kind sweeps match Salzberg and Sayama's colony-density adaptation (2004). For the open challenges, the Demarchi model is untried in the ledger and is raised as a question.
